other_failure_modes.description: The model uses a validation set for early stopping during training, and then reports the final performance on that exact same validation set. This biases the evaluation metric because the model was explicitly tuned to perform well on that specific set.

summary: The agent provides a generally well-structured solution with good feature engineering and an intelligent weighted ensembling strategy.
